name: Uniform Volume Ray Marching
definition: A rendering technique for uniform volumes (constant opacity and density) using ray marching to estimate the integral of light scattering. It assumes a single light source and constant volume properties, allowing precomputation of attenuation factors.
summary: Uniform Volume Ray Marching renders participating media with constant density by using fixed step sizes and precomputed attenuation, distinguishing itself from non-uniform methods through its strict assumption of uniform volume properties.
